intent: Use this package as a standard example for documenting a new relational operational database.
review_steps: Confirm the primary task table and its tenant scope column.
Verify that assignee and location tables are correct.
Replace generic aliases with business language from the real product.
Review report SQL against production-safe filters.
Check that manual glossary and semantics match actual joins and derived logic.
acceptance_criteria: Every critical table has a clear description and aliases.
Tenant scope is explicit for every tenant-bound table.
At least one reliable list query template exists for each primary entity.
Business terms in glossary map cleanly to real schema objects.
Predefined reports execute without ambiguous joins.
